command: openclaw gateway --port 19099 --force --allow-unconfigured, one `openclaw tui --session <fresh>` turn, then SIGTERM
note: All SIX hooks the plugin registers, from one run. The turn has to go through `openclaw tui`, not `openclaw agent`: the four session hooks fire from the gateway's get-reply path, which `agent` never enters — an earlier capture got only the gateway pair and read like drift. `session_start` additionally needs a FRESH session key; a reused one resumes and stays silent. Note the order: `session_end` lands AFTER `gateway_stop`, because shutdown is what closes the session. The turn also spawned a Claude Code backend whose own hooks reached the recorder through the inherited PIXTUOID_SOCKET; filtered out.
